customisationOptions.option: Add the Nile Feast lunch package
customisationOptions.source: An English-speaking assistant and one bottle of mineral water per person are included; a lunch (onboard or riverside) is an optional add-on, chosen at booking.

customisationOptions.option: Choose lunch onboard or at a riverside restaurant
customisationOptions.source: The choice is straightforward: a table at a riverside restaurant overlooking the water, or a meal served directly on the felucca while under sail.

customisationOptions.option: Drift longer around the islands or turn back early
customisationOptions.source: The boat is privately yours, though — it can drift longer around the islands or turn back early without apology.

customisationOptions.option: Choose a morning or afternoon sailing window
customisationOptions.source: The concierge can recommend the best window: morning sails are noticeably cooler than afternoon ones from May onward.
